messages.author: cbaf432548852c3b
messages.subject: methSeg loading file
parts:
Dear Dr. Altuna,

Greetings. I'm working on methSeg in methylKit and has been gone through the example.

To be applied to my results,

1) may I know what is the file "H1.chr21.chr22.rds" (what information inside this file?) and

2) where should I generate file mimic "H1.chr21.chr22.rds" as shown in example?

Kindly please advise, appreciate that.

Thank you very much and have a nice day!

Best wishes,
Lim

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] methSeg loading file
parts:
The data is here:
https://github.com/BIMSBbioinfo/compgen2018/tree/master/day3_diffMeth/data

unfortunately the link is broken. it should be a GRanges object for methylation values per base.
